plan: My private value is $9. In a second-price sealed bid auction, the optimal strategy is typically to bid my true value. If I bid below my value, I risk losing the item even when winning would be profitable. If I bid above my value, I risk paying more than the item is worth to me. Since values are independent and this is a one-round game, I'll bid my exact value of $9.
